description: In 1970s Colombia, mysterious Eva Samper becomes the first girl at an all-boys school and unsettles its routines, assumptions and friendships. Camilo falls for her as their classmates confront changing ideas about literature, relationships, family, politics and growing up. Season 3 in this collection runs from "Jane Eyre" through "The Plague", preserving the collection-local episode order and source runtimes.

s03e01.description: As major exams loom – and bring startling revelations — Camilo enlists the Acuña brothers for an illicit mission. José attempts to woo Ana.

s03e02.description: An impending military exam causes strife among Salcedo, Pabón, Castro and Arbeláez. A new play and a new face turn Salcedo's life upside down.

s03e03.description: A military draft throws the gang into disarray right before graduation. As Eva's life grows more complicated, so does her relationship with Camilo.

s03e04.description: As the future unfolds, so do the group's opportunities. Lucy's announcement angers José. Pabón and Quiñonez clash in the military.

s03e05.description: Camilo, Eva and the gang enter into a new chapter of their lives. Janet's suggestion takes José by surprise. Pabón turns the tables on Quiñonez.

s03e06.description: Pabón helps Quiñonez. As Camilo struggles with Eva's interest in their professor, a wild night unleashes his insecurities. Ana receives good news.

s03e07.description: Camilo's jealousy blinds him as Eva's secrets mount. Pabón pushes back on the military's decision. José makes a special request of Camilo.

s03e08.description: Reeling from Eva's decision, Camilo spirals. Salcedo's drug use presents consequences for the group. An idea gives Camilo a new opportunity.

s03e09.description: As the police search for Eva, she comes clean about Silva's affiliations. An old face reunites with Salcedo and Luisa. A house party goes awry.

s03e10.description: Luisa and Arbeláez plan their future as a phone call urges Eva back to the U.S. Pabón confronts Quiñonez. Camilo falls deeper into the friend zone.
